turns.replyText:
Which of your products is best for that, and why is it a good fit?
Our flagship Beastgrip Pro universal rig and Pro Series lens bundles are designed to deliver top-tier performance.
The Beastgrip Pro is our most versatile rig, compatible with virtually any Apple iPhone or Android smartphone. Built from high-strength materials with custom brass lens mount threads, it provides a secure, steady grip with standard cold shoe mounts and 1/4"-20 threads for attaching handles, tripods, microphones, and lights.
For the ultimate quality setup, pairing the rig with our Beastgrip x Kenko Pro Series lenses gives you incredible optical clarity with zero chromatic aberration or edge distortion. They are crafted specifically to withstand heavy professional use.
